expectations.buyer: Pipe, valve, fitting, coating, membrane, and drinking-water material manufacturers plus laboratories and certification bodies
expectations.pain: Formulations and migration test evidence must meet EU positive-list and hygiene requirements before market access
expectations.strongestIncumbent: EU implementing acts and positive lists, accredited migration laboratories, national certification schemes, material suppliers, and regulatory consultants
expectations.biggestRisk: A formulation preflight cannot replace migration testing, confidential composition may be inaccessible, and official lists or lab portals may absorb rule checking
